name: prozkid1
label: Give kid prozac if is hostile

questions.text:
How likely would you be to give doctor prescribed Prozac to your child or a child you were responsible for in the following situations (A child would be considered anyone between the age of 8 and 15). 
A. ...because s/he is hostile, often loses his/her temper, often argues with adults, actively defies authority and seems spiteful or vindictive.
questions.stem: How likely would you be to give doctor prescribed Prozac to your child or a child you were responsible for in the following situations (A child would be considered anyone between the age of 8 and 15).
questions.item: A. ...because s/he is hostile, often loses his/her temper, often argues with adults, actively defies authority and seems spiteful or vindictive.

name: prozkid2
label: Give kid prozac if is not paying attention

questions.text:
How likely would you be to give doctor prescribed Prozac to your child or a child you were responsible for in the following situations (A child would be considered anyone between the age of 8 and 15). 
B. ...because s/he is not paying attention at school, does not follow through with school work and chores, 

has difficulty organizing activities, is easily distracted, talks excessively, and seems to run around or fidget constantly.

B. ...because s/he is talking about killing him or herself.
